description: This PHP source file handles uploading and caching of image files submitted through a form, validating MIME types and file extensions, and returning the cached file paths as a JSON response.

classes.name: UploadFile
classes.description: A class used to manage file uploads, including validation and moving files to designated upload paths.

methods.name: confirm_upload
methods.description: Checks whether the uploaded file is valid and ready to be moved.

methods.name: final_move
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to its final destination with a new GUID name.

methods.name: get_stored_file_name
methods.description: Returns the stored filename after upload.

methods.name: get_upload_path
methods.description: Provides the full upload path for the stored file based on GUID.
